head: frfṭ (< Anat. Arb. prpt or frft/ṭ ‘zarpeln, flattern, sich hin und herwerfen’ VW I 59, VW II 94;)

detransitiveSenses.gloss: (Detrans.) röcheln, schnaufen, die Bewegungen eines sterbenden, krepierenden machen, sterben, krepieren;

stems.detransitiveSensesRaw: (Detrans.) röcheln, schnaufen, die Bewegungen eines sterbenden, krepierenden machen, sterben, krepieren;

examples.raw: bʕīǧ, mayəṯ, mfarfəṭ ʻer erschickte, starb, röchelteʼ; 775;

examples.turoyo: Naqqa i qaṭәn xila naqqa mfarfṭo
examples.translation: As soon as the cat ate, then she sniffled. suddenly died
examples.raw: Naqqa i qaṭәn xila naqqa mfarfṭo ‘As soon as the cat ate, then she sniffled. suddenly died’ 004_NE_Ditin_Hezar; 12:23

examples.translation: I saw that [the cow] was panting
examples.raw: hama ḥzeli: gava kale ko-mifarfəṭ ʻI saw that [the cow] was pantingʼ; 775; 44/111;

examples.turoyo: kul=lalyo (…) šəmʕi-wa qole d-ʕezo oṯe-wa qarén mina qaymi-wa əzzehən-wa ga ʕezo kal-ko-mifarfto
examples.translation: Every night (...) they heard the voice of a goat, the moan came from it, they stood up, went (and saw): the goat was in death-agony
examples.raw: kul=lalyo (…) šəmʕi-wa qole d-ʕezo oṯe-wa qarén mina qaymi-wa əzzehən-wa ga ʕezo kal-ko-mifarfto ‘Every night (...) they heard the voice of a goat, the moan came from it, they stood up, went (and saw): the goat was in death-agony’ LuF 304/67;
